caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bench with three sections on the backrest, each section featuring a painted rectangular panel decorated with fruit and floral motifs in muted tones of reds, oranges, yellows, and greens. The arms of the bench are curved and extend outward with a scroll-like shape at the ends. Vertical spindles connect the seat to the backrest and form part of the structure beneath the arms. The seat of the bench is simple and flat, supported by turned legs that are braced with stretchers for stability. The wood is depicted in a light, muted greenish-brown color, and there are subtle decorative details painted along the front edge and lower back supports of the bench. The artist's name, "ROSA BURGER," is written in the lower right corner. The drawing is made on a cream-colored background and is framed within a faint rectangular border.
title: Settee
